plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Surgical/Central Sterile Processing Technology, Basic Technical Certificate' program page (Major Code: 4412V), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/health-professions-department/surgical-central-sterile-processing-technology/surgicalcentral-sterile-processing-technology-basic-technical-certificate . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Basic Technical Certificate (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 10, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 10'; the page also prints 'Total Credit Hours Required for this Major: 10'); the single 'Post-Admission Program Requirements' block sums exactly. Program admission: students must meet with the program director before declaring this major (not a course in this plan). After program completion plus 400 hours of on-the-job work, graduates are eligible for the IAACSMM national certification exam. Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
